verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email app, but the evidence shows no self-hosted deployment option for Missive. It only shows that Missive can connect to user-run IMAP/SMTP servers, and a community report notes that mail is fetched via Missive's own servers. Connecting to your own mail server is an adjacent capability and does not amount to self-hosting the app or controlling the mail pipeline.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
